name: Nakatsugawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakatsugawa city emblem in blue: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised character with a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Nakatsugawa, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 August 1976; the emblem dates from 19 December 1955.

features.role: Nakatsugawa city emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised character with a vertical bar
